understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate each level’s grid to complete all goal cells. A goal is completed by stepping onto its cell only when the carried piece simultaneously matches the goal’s required shape, color, and rotation; completing all goals advances to the next level, and finishing all levels wins.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs 1 stamina and you can move only in unblocked directions (walls prevent movement; attempting a blocked direction wastes the move and stamina without changing position). When stamina reaches 0, you lose 1 life and stamina resets to its maximum; losing all lives ends the game (GAME_OVER). Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape tiles cycle shape IDs 0–5 (wrap), color tiles cycle orange → blue → green → red → orange, and rotation tiles rotate 90° clockwise (0° → 90° → 180° → 270° → 0°). A goal activates only when shape, color, and rotation all match, then stepping onto it completes it.
